title: nebula-receipt-linkage-and-manifest-seals-v614
implementation: Added a V614 receipt linker that validates canonical v592 manifest seals, associated asset-build receipt seals, declared receipt hashes, and per-item NASA ID/target/source URL/local path/bytes/SHA-256 linkage.

Kept raw manifest hashes separate from canonical manifest seals and made the closure tarantula-nebula / tarantula-nebula-closure relationship explicit through NASA ID PIA23646 rather than target-string equality.

Added fail-closed receipt-linkage tests for missing references, tampered URL/path/bytes/digest, invalid receipt seals, identity-only metadata receipts, deterministic fingerprints, and alias resolution.

Added typed V614 linkage presentation helpers and tests for status labels, risk ordering, summary completion, evidence paths, alias paths, shape validation, and stable UI formatting; the review panel now displays the first linked receipt status without turning linkage into a rights grant.

Regenerated the V613 rights pack so every candidate carries manifest seal identity, receipt references, per-reference linkage, and top-level linkage summary while all 18 item-level rights decisions remain pending.

codeChange.method: Count nonblank, noncomment lines in the four new R54 linker and typed UI utility files. Existing V613 generator/pack and review-panel integration edits are additional and are not needed to reach the threshold.
